object.name: evi_quadfmpm
object.digest: Quadrature FM/PM Oscillators by Lionel and Graham
object.description: This is a quadrature FM/PM xfading mod/carrier setup, based on LIONEL's patch from: https://cycling74.com/forums/fm-vs-pm-in-gen-unwanted-artifacts-clicks , with additions by Graham Wakefield. I have not been able to ask Lionel's permission. If you are Lionel and you see this, please get in touch.

constructor.inlets: pitch, index, fm/pm, fm/pm, mod, car, mod

inlets.name: pitch
inlets.digest: Controls the pitch of the oscillators in floating point MIDI note values.

inlets.name: index
inlets.digest: The FM Index, zero-latched to the modulating oscillator. Index multiplies the amount of Modulator sent to the Carrier. Integer boundaries will sound harmonic, non integer values will sound inharmonic. The greater the index value the more complexity in the resulting signal.

inlets.name: fm/pm
inlets.digest: Inlet 3 controls the range of modulation of FM or PM circuits (depending on the mix position of inlet 4).

inlets.name: fm/pm
inlets.digest: Inlet 4 (along with inlet 3) is used to derive FM and PM amounts. Inlet 4 0..1 mixes between the FM circuit and the PM circuit to modulate the oscillators. This is a brilliant Graham Wakefield idea.

inlets.name: mod
inlets.digest: Inlet 5 controls the feedback amount in the Modulation oscillator.

inlets.name: car
inlets.digest: Inlet 6 controls the feedback amount in the Carrier oscillator.

inlets.name: mod
inlets.digest: Controls the modulation factor of the oscillators frequency in Hz (derived from the pitch at inlet 1).
